Uses: a variable is used at a statement when its name is read while that statement executes. Within one execution of one statement, a variable counts as used at most once even if its name appears several times (e.g. `a[k] + a[k+1]` is one use of `a`). Uses are processed before defs of the same statement, so `cost += delta_cost` on line 131 pairs its read of `cost` with the def that reached it from earlier (possibly line 131 itself in an earlier iteration). A use inside the loop counts once per iteration in which it executes. `count` = total number of such observations summed over all invocations in all test methods.
